hardRules.noOddNumbers: All spacing, font sizes, border radius, padding, margins, gaps must be even numbers
hardRules.noHardcodedHex: Every color must come from a variable, no exceptions
hardRules.noHardcodedFonts: Every font must reference the font variable
hardRules.iconsStrokeOnly: All icons use strokes, never fills. Bind stroke on VECTOR child, not frame wrapper
hardRules.noFixedHeight: Never hardcode height on components, use auto-layout with counterAxisSizingMode AUTO

colors.description: 3-tier color token architecture: Primitives (raw hex, no modes) -> Themes (semantic, 4 modes) -> Components. Components NEVER reference Primitives directly.

typography.description: 19 text styles across 3 font families. All sizes even, minimum 10px. Font families switchable via variables.

fontFamilies.name: Roboto Mono
fontFamilies.usage: Code snippets, technical data, keyboard shortcuts

icons.description: 425 icon components, all stroke-only with colors bound to variables. Every component must use these icons via instance swap.

categories.name: Product icons (colored)
categories.description: Zoho product logos, brand colors preserved

sizes.context: Inline with Body/SM, Label/MD, small buttons

rules: Bind stroke on VECTOR child, not frame wrapper
Aspect ratio locked on all icon components

spacing.description: Token-driven spacing scale. All values even numbers.

elevation.description: 5 shadow effect styles for elevation hierarchy

componentKeyMap._description: Quick lookup: UI element → componentKey + import method. type=component_set → importComponentSetByKeyAsync (then .defaultVariant.createInstance). type=component → importComponentByKeyAsync (then .createInstance). status=manual → build with frames, not imported.

components.name: Container
components.description: Max-width wrapper component used to constrain content width and center it on the page. Handles horizontal padding and max-width constraints.
whenToUse: Constraining page content to a max-width
Centering content horizontally on wide screens
whenNotToUse: For sidebar or panel content (use Stack/Column)

components.name: Stack
components.description: Generic auto-layout container that stacks children horizontally or vertically with configurable alignment and gap. The most fundamental layout building block after Container.
whenToUse: Grouping related elements with consistent spacing

components.name: Grid
components.description: Multi-column grid layout component. Distributes children into equal-width columns with configurable gap. Wraps content into rows automatically.
whenToUse: Card grids, product listings, image galleries

components.name: Row
components.description: Horizontal flex container with alignment options. Distributes children along the horizontal axis with configurable spacing. Supports space-between and space-around distribution.
whenToUse: Distributing items horizontally with equal spacing
whenNotToUse: When items need to wrap (use Grid)

components.name: Column
components.description: Vertical flex container with span property. Stacks children vertically with configurable alignment and gap. Stretch variant fills children to full width.
whenToUse: Stacking content vertically in a sidebar

components.name: Spacer
components.description: Fixed space element using spacing tokens. Insert between elements to create precise, token-driven gaps without margin hacks.
whenToUse: When auto-layout gap isn't enough (mixed spacing)
Creating visual breathing room between sections

tokens.fill: color/bg/brand-subtle (visible in design, transparent in code)

components.name: Divider
components.description: Horizontal or vertical line separator. Solid or dashed style. Uses border color variables for automatic theme compatibility.
whenToUse: Between list items or menu groups

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.description: Fixed ratio container for images, videos, and media. Clips content to maintain consistent proportions across different content sizes.
whenToUse: Image thumbnails in cards and grids

components.name: Overlay
components.description: Semi-transparent dark background layer behind modals, drawers, and dialogs. Dims underlying content to focus attention on foreground elements. Always dark regardless of theme mode.
whenToUse: Behind modals and dialogs to dim background
whenNotToUse: Without a foreground element on top

tokens.fill: color/bg/overlay (aliased to neutral/950 in ALL modes)

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Circular loading indicator for async operations. Shows indeterminate progress while content loads. Animated via interactive component states with smart animate transition.

components.name: Shimmer
components.description: Animated loading placeholder that mimics content shape. Uses gradient sweep animation in code. Static representation in Figma.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Static loading placeholder that mimics content shape and layout. Unlike Shimmer, Skeleton has no animation. Use for content-first loading where animation would be distracting.
whenToUse: Form field placeholders during async load

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status indicator showing counts or dot-only presence. Used on navigation items, avatars, and list items. Supports solid and subtle styles across 6 semantic colors.
whenToUse: Notification counts on nav items or icons
Status indicators on list items or cards

components.name: Label
components.description: Form field label with optional required indicator, optional text hint, and info icon. Used above or beside input fields to identify their purpose.
whenToUse: Above form fields to identify inputs
Show required indicator for mandatory fields
Add info icon for fields needing explanation

components.name: Helper Text
components.description: Contextual text below form fields providing hints, validation feedback, or error messages. Color-coded by state with optional status icon.
whenToUse: Below form inputs for validation feedback
Show error messages on invalid input

components.name: Link
components.description: Navigational text element for in-page or external links. Always uses standard blue color regardless of theme (not brand color). Supports 5 interaction states and optional icons.
whenToUse: Navigation to other pages or sections
External links with trailing arrow icon
Inline links within body text paragraphs
whenNotToUse: For actions that change data (use Button)
For primary calls to action (use Button)

components.name: Kbd
components.description: Keyboard key indicator displaying shortcut keys. Uses Roboto Mono for consistent monospace rendering. Styled as a subtle raised key with border and bottom shadow.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Contextual popup providing additional information on hover or focus. Dark background with white text for high contrast. Supports optional heading, icon, and link.
whenNotToUse: For critical info users must see (use Alert)

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary action trigger with 4 visual types, 4 colors, 5 sizes, and 4 interaction states. Part of a 4-component button system (Button, Split Button, Icon Button, Nav Button).

components.name: Split Button
components.description: Two-zone button with primary action (left) and dropdown trigger (right). Two separate hover zones with independent states. Same sizing as Button.

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Buttons component set

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only button with no text. Same variant properties and sizing as Button. Used for compact action triggers.

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Buttons component set

whenNotToUse: When text label is needed (use Button)
When action is unclear without text

components.name: Nav Button
components.description: Navigation-specific button with Round and Square shape options. Simplified variant model focused on navigation use cases.

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Buttons component set

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line text field for capturing user input. 5 sizes matching button heights, 5 interaction states, optional leading/trailing icons. Composes Label and Helper Text.
whenToUse: Short text: names, emails, search queries, URLs
Prefix icons to indicate type (search, email)

components.name: Password Input
components.description: Password field with masked input and show/hide visibility toggle. Same sizing and state model as Text Input.

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Text Box

whenNotToUse: Visible text that needs to stay visible
keyDifferences: Filled content shows dots instead of text
Lock icon as default left icon

components.name: Number Input
components.description: Numeric input field with two type options: Stepper (chevron up/down on right) and Button (minus/plus icon buttons flanking the field).

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Text Box

whenNotToUse: Large number entry (use Text Input with validation)

typeDetails.Stepper: Chevron-up/down stacked vertically on right. Icon sizes: XS/Small=10px, Medium/Default=12px, Large=14px.
typeDetails.Button: Minus icon button (left) + field + Plus icon button (right), using Icon Button Secondary Neutral (350:722). Text center-aligned.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multiline text input for longer-form content. 3 sizes with minimum heights, character count display, and same state model as other inputs.
whenNotToUse: Rich text editing (use rich text editor)
keyDifferences: Uses Zoho Puvi Regular (not Medium) for body text

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Binary on/off control. Pill-shaped track with circular thumb. 2 sizes, label hidden by default. Custom variable toggle-thumb-off handles dark mode thumb visibility.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Compact labels for categorization, filtering, and selections. Used standalone or composed inside Select/Dropdown for multi-select options.

components.name: Select
components.description: Dropdown selector for single or multi-select options. Uses same sizing and colors as Text Input. 4 content types: placeholder, single selected, multi-select chips with +3more, and comma-separated.

contentTypes.Placeholder: Select option text in placeholder color
contentTypes.Selected: Option selected in primary text, single value

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Binary or tri-state selection control. Supports unchecked, checked, and indeterminate states with optional label and description text. Single size (16x16 box).

components.name: Radio
components.description: Single selection control for mutually exclusive options. Circular indicator with white dot when selected, optional label and description text. Single size (16x16 ring).

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Circular user representation showing image placeholder, initials, or icon. 3 sizes with optional green status indicator for online presence.

components.name: Image
components.description: Aspect-ratio container for displaying images with loading placeholder, loaded, and error states. 3 ratios, 6px radius, clips content.

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Horizontal bar indicating task completion or loading state. Supports determinate (percentage fill) and indeterminate (animated sliding bar in code). 3 track heights, 4 colors.

components.name: Progress Circle
components.description: Circular progress indicator for task completion or loading. Uses stroke-based ring with arc progress. 3 sizes, optional center percentage label.

components.name: Rating
components.description: Star-based rating display for user reviews and feedback. 5 stars with filled/empty states. Interactive selection handled in code.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Expandable/collapsible content sections with chevron rotation.
whenToUse: Grouping related content that can be shown/hidden
whenNotToUse: When all content should always be visible

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tab bar for switching between content views. Primary tabs go in Sub Header, secondary tabs inside Container.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Hierarchical navigation trail with separator icons.
whenToUse: Showing current location in navigation tree

components.name: Table
components.description: Data table with sortable columns, row selection, and configurable cells.
whenToUse: Displaying structured data with multiple columns

components.name: Attention Box
components.description: Banner notification with status color, icon, and message. Used for warnings, info, success, and error alerts.

components.name: Card BG
components.description: Card background component with themed surface colors.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Floating menu container with menu items, dividers, and submenus.

components.name: Gradient Button
components.description: Button with gradient fill for premium/special CTA actions.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Multi-step process indicator with completed/active/pending states.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page navigation with prev/next buttons and page numbers.
whenNotToUse: Short lists that fit one page

components.name: Key Value Pair
components.description: Key-value pairs display for detail views and info sections.

components.name: Double Field
components.description: Two input fields side by side for related paired data entry.

components.name: Popup
components.description: Default popup/dialog container for confirmations and forms.

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Zero-data state with illustration, message, and CTA.

components.name: Layout
components.description: Full Catalyst page layout component with ServiceMenu, Header, Sidemenu, Sub Header, and Container.

components.name: Sidemenu
components.description: Side navigation menu component with grouped menu items.
